{{Quote|Welcome to Ferrix terminal. Please make sure to check in your baggage before departing.|An announcement aboard a shuttle ferry|<ref name="Reckoning">{{Andor|Reckoning (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''HFY-3920 shuttle ferry''', also known simply as a '''shuttle ferry''', was a [[Color|red]]-and-beige two-[[engine]], single-[[pilot]] [[repulsorcraft]] [[shuttle]] manufactured by [[Ferrix Field Yards]] that operated on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]] by [[5 BBY]]. The [[Ferrix Entry Ferry Service]] used shuttle ferries for [[transport]]ing passengers to and from the [[Ferrix City|town center]]. [[Axis network|Rebel network]] coordinator [[Luthen Rael]] used a shuttle ferry in 5 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], as did one of his network's [[Spy|spies]] [[Vel Sartha]] and ex-[[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces|Pre-Mor Enforcement]] [[Tac-Corpo|officers]] [[Syril Karn]] and [[Linus Mosk]] several [[Standard week|weeks]] later.

==Characteristics==
The HFY-3920<ref name="SWE" /> shuttle ferry<ref name="Audio description">{{Andor|Reckoning (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> was a type of two-[[engine]] [[repulsorcraft]] [[shuttle]]<ref name="Reckoning" /> manufactured by [[Ferrix Field Yards]].<ref name="SWE" /> The exterior of the [[starship]] was painted in [[Color|red]] and beige, with the text "FERRIX ENTRY FERRY SERVICE" [[Writing|written]] on its side<ref name="Reckoning" /> in [[Bazeese script]];<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=andor-s1-e12-trivia-gallery|text="Rix Road" Trivia Gallery | Andor}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref> individual ferries also had their engine number written next to the company name with capital letters. The ferries' two engine units were located in the rear.<ref name="Reckoning" />

[[File:Shuttle_ferry_pilot.png|thumb|left|250px|The pilot of a shuttle ferry was seated in an elevated cockpit.]]
A shuttle ferry had a spacious interior including standing space and seating for at least thirty-one passengers arranged in sets of four along with a rear gallery. It also included overhead space for their luggage.<ref name="Ep2" /> It was driven by a single [[pilot|ferry operator]]<ref name="SWE" /> who was seated in an elevated [[glass]] [[cockpit]] in the front of the ship.<ref name="Ep2" /> Entry and exit from the vehicle was facilitated by use of a [[staircase droid]], which was deployed in [[Ferrix shuttle port|ferry stations]], and a [[mirror]] opposite to the door.<ref name="Reckoning" /> A [[Viewscreen|screen]] above the door displayed information about the ship's destination, and overhead lights as well as wide windows offered a clear view of the surrounding locales.<ref name="Ep2" />

==Role==
Shuttle ferries were used as civilian [[City|intercity]] passenger [[transport]]s.<ref name="Ep2" />

==History==
{{Quote|You believe this? Incredible, right. We're circling, stacked up. ''[…]'' We should be charging them.|Willi complaining to Luthen Rael about the ferries' fare rates|<ref name="Ep2" />}}
[[File:Ferrix-shuttle-int.png|thumb|right|300px|Luthen Rael (left) rides in the passenger section of a shuttle ferry.]]
HFY-3920 shuttle ferries were operated on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]] by the [[Ferrix Entry Ferry Service]], which used them for [[standard year|years]] to serve both commuting workers and visiting off-worlders. As [[Ferrix City]]'s footprint expanded, the ferry service became increasingly necessary. Routes began in remote valleys, where passengers boarded the ferries from their personal [[starship]]s, and ended in Ferrix City's [[Ferrix Terminal]].<ref name="SWE" />

By [[5 BBY]],<ref name="102Date">{{AndorDate|102}}</ref><ref name="103Date">{{AndorDate|103}}</ref> Ferrix Entry Ferry Service operated at least three different shuttle ferries, including [[Engine 22]], to ferry passengers from shuttle stations scattered around the planet to the Ferrix Terminal<ref name="Ep2" /> as well as to the planet's [[spaceport]].<ref name="N5" /> Upon landing on Ferrix to meet with his [[Bix Caleen|local contact's]] seller, [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]],<ref name="Reckoning" /> in 5 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]],<ref name="102Date" /><ref name="103Date" /> [[Luthen Rael]], the coordinator of a [[Axis network|rebel network]], used Engine 22 to carry him from a ferry station close to the remote valley where he had landed his [[Luthen Rael's Fondor Haulcraft|Fondor Haulcraft]], to the Ferrixian town.<ref name="Ep2" />

During transit, he struck up a conversation with a fellow passenger, [[Willi]], who complained about shuttle ferry rates and warned him about [[Thief|pickpockets]].<ref name="Ep2" /> One [[Standard month|month]] later, while departing for<ref name="N5">{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="UltimateSWNE">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> [[Coruscant]] to meet with her [[Mothma family|cousin]] [[Mon Mothma]],<ref name="NL">{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}}</ref> Rael's network's [[spy]] [[Vel Sartha]] used a shuttle ferry to leave the town.<ref name="N5" /> Several [[Standard day|days]] later, ex–[[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces|Pre-Mor Enforcement]] [[Tac-Corpo|officers]] [[Linus Mosk]] and [[Syril Karn]], posing as locals, took a ferry to the Ferrixian town to investigate Andor's possible presence at his [[Maarva Carassi Andor|mother's]] upcoming [[Maarva's funeral procession|funeral]].<ref name="RR">{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The shuttle ferry first appeared in "[[That Would Be Me]]," the second episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the [[Disney+]] live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="Ep2" /> released on [[September 21]], [[2022]].<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}}</ref> It was identified as a "shuttle ferry" in the audio description of the next episode, "[[Reckoning (episode)|Reckoning]],"<ref name="Audio description" /> released the same day.<ref name="Trailer" /> The [[2024]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' further identified the ferry's model as HFY-3920.<ref name="SWE" />
